findings.finding: Finite geometry, reversible autocorrelations and selected persistent modes promoted to physical dimension rankings and universal no-wave exclusions.
findings.resolution: Retain specified kernels, even-lag stationary bound and finite continuous-time spectral theorem; restore beta-zero, aliased stencils, negative-real persistent multipliers and endpoint exceptions; no universal wave or source-limit conclusion.

findings.finding: Unneutralized torus sources, clock-only direction claims with general base weights, wrong heat-bath normalization, rate products treated as probabilities, and onsite anticommutation treated as zero rest energy.
findings.resolution: Neutralize torus sources, require constant diagonal for recomputed pair law, restrict uniform directions to W=1 with rate w/12, distinguish transverse ray projection and exact normalized birth probabilities, preserve scalar onsite-energy counterexample and separate coupling hypotheses.

findings.finding: Missing load-bearing certificate JSON and unjustified nonnegative equality multipliers or infinite-lattice extrapolation.
findings.resolution: Include and validate all18 certificate/rate tables; allow signed equality multipliers but require nonnegative separating coefficient and positive lower-bound contraction. Independently reconstruct every four-record row by forward events on finite torus and actual sparse infinite lattice. State exact rate-class, positive-move and full signed-permutation assumptions.

findings.finding: Formal expansions and finite rational inequalities promoted to causality, coexistence, global branch stability and all-sector mass conclusions.
findings.resolution: Restrict to explicit quadratic action and nondegenerate modes, withdraw unproved contour/coexistence extension, distinguish coefficient zero from phase transition, state conditional rotational tangent and source projection, exact density endpoints and finite-box capacity boundaries. C2 onset, degenerate kinetic coefficient and finite inverse controls supplied.

findings.finding: Flat bands called no motion, parity applied on odd tori, unchanged linear holonomy called unchanged connection, and endpoint self-adjointness inferred from finite stencils.
findings.resolution: Retain bounded transport with actual dimer motion; require even periodic sides for parity; distinguish connection from curvature, and unperturbed data from complete ledgers. Declare verified endpoint-theory imports and correct real-gauge phase, boundary-line translation, Wronskian/domain covariance. Finite clock sum is not an arrival-time theorem.

findings.finding: Historical support and checker output treated as current broad evidence.
findings.resolution: Fifteen fresh runners, fifteen independent mathematical controls and fifteen caught mutations;189 ancillary dispositions preserved on original branches. Full AST exactness scans and parent inputs;46 canonical files include necessary certificate data. Three author head updates read and reconciled before final freeze. No audit verdict or physical premise adopted.
